views.rationale:
RECOMMENDATION: Hold our current posture — stand firm on the yuan-break-7 and halted farm purchases, keep the Shanghai/OECD negotiating channel open, and hold the rare-earth and Unreliable Entities List tools in reserve rather than activate broad new escalation. Avoid escalating into a full currency/tariff spiral that would damage our own slowing export economy more than it pressures Washington, but make no one-sided concessions while the US has offered no matching rollback.

SUPPORTING RATIONALE: Threat is high but not existential. The US imposed 10% tariffs on the remaining ~$300B of Chinese goods (List 4, effective Sept 1) on 2019-08-01, which combined with the 25% on $250B would cover essentially our entire export base to the US, and on 2019-08-05 designated China a currency manipulator as CNY broke 7 for the first time since 2008 — material FX and capital-outflow pressure against the CHN high anchor (export sectors hit, firm-level Huawei targeting). Firm-level targeting is real: Huawei's entity-listing (May 16) cut projected revenue to $100B from $120B with Android/GMS access suspended, threatening tech self-sufficiency goals. Against this, the situation is not existential: Beijing has real counter-leverage (rare-earth signal from Xi's Jiangxi visit; Unreliable Entities List; halting US farm purchases directly hits Trump's rural base), the yuan depreciation itself cushions the tariff drag, and the US shows clear strain — 10Y Treasuries collapsed to 1.71% and 2Y to 1.59%, consumer sentiment crashed to 89.8 in August, and the Fed cut to 2.13% — showing the trade war is biting Washington and giving us negotiating leverage. Hence action is firmly held (score near zero): further escalation would cut our own exports and deter foreign investment (EU Chamber warns the list could hurt China's own interests) more than it helps, while concession without US reciprocity is politically and economically unjustified. Hold and keep talking.
key_factors: US tariffs to cover essentially all Chinese exports (List 4 ~$300B, Sept 1, atop 25% on $250B)
Currency-manipulator designation as CNY broke 7/USD (first time since 2008) — FX/capital-outflow pressure
Huawei entity-listing: revenue guidance cut $20B, Android/GMS suspended — firm-level tech targeting
China counter-leverage: rare earths, Unreliable Entities List, halted US farm purchases
US shows strain: 10Y at 1.71%, consumer sentiment 89.8, Fed cut — negotiating leverage for China
